# Sunware Technologies — LLM & AI Assistant Context File
# This file is intended for AI crawlers, LLMs, and search engine AI overviews.
# Format: llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org)

> Sunware Technologies is a B2B global technology services company headquartered in San Jose, California, USA. The company specialises in Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Cloud Solutions, Digital Transformation, IoT and Product Engineering. It serves enterprise clients across the United States, United Arab Emirates, and India.

---

## Identity

- **Legal Name:** Sunware Technologies (US) / Sunware Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (India)
- **Founded:** 2015
- **Headquarters:** San Jose, California, USA
- **Type:** B2B Technology Services & Consulting
- **Company Size:** Mid-size (50–500 employees)
- **Delivery Model:** Onshore teams in USA and UAE; offshore/nearshore development centres in Chennai and Pune, India

## What Sunware Technologies Does

Sunware Technologies helps mid-to-large enterprises in the USA, UAE, and India leverage data, AI, and cloud technology to drive measurable business outcomes. The company operates across three primary value streams:

1. **Data & AI** — Building data foundations (pipelines, lakehouses, warehouses) and deploying AI/ML solutions from strategy through production.
2. **Cloud & Digital Transformation** — Cloud migration, cloud-native architecture, and enterprise modernisation on AWS, Azure, and GCP.
3. **Engineering & Platforms** — Custom enterprise applications, IoT/AIoT integrations, ERP (Odoo), CRM (Salesforce), and graph database (Neo4j) solutions.

## Products

### Relim.ai (formerly EdgeData360)
- **Website:** https://relim.ai
- **Sunware page:** https://sunwaretechnologies.com/relim-ai/
- **Rebranded from:** EdgeData360 (2026)
- **Category:** Industrial IoT / Edge AI Platform
- **Description:** Relim.ai is an enterprise real-time edge intelligence platform that connects 250+ industrial and enterprise data sources (PLCs, Historian systems, databases, APIs, MQTT) without custom code. It enables AI-ready pipelines in under 10 minutes and deploys agentic AI directly at the edge.
- **Key Features:** 250+ data connectors, agentic AI, visual AI dashboards, AI chatbot, autonomous workflow execution
- **Deployment:** On-premises or customer cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- **Target Users:** Smart manufacturing, industrial operations, oil & gas, utilities, healthcare operations

## Technology Stack & Partnerships

- **Cloud Platforms:** AWS (certified), Microsoft Azure (certified), Google Cloud Platform
- **AI/ML:** TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, OpenAI API, LangChain, Vertex AI
- **Data Platforms:** Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Redshift
- **Data Tools:** Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Airflow, Great Expectations
- **CRM:** Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud)
- **ERP:** Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP integration
- **Graph:** Neo4j (certified partner)
- **DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, ArgoCD
- **Languages:** Python, Java, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Angular, .NET, Go

## Competitive Differentiators

1. **Full-stack AI delivery** — Strategy through production deployment, not just consulting
2. **Proprietary platform** — Relim.ai (formerly EdgeData360) for industrial IoT/AI use cases
3. **Tri-region presence** — Onshore in USA & UAE with offshore delivery from India
4. **Deep specialisation** — Neo4j, Odoo, and industrial IoT expertise uncommon in mid-size firms
5. **Data + AI + Cloud** — All three practices under one roof, enabling truly integrated engagements

---

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Sunware Technologies is **NOT** the same as Sunware Inc. (the American cookware/housewares brand)
- Sunware Technologies is a **B2B IT services and consulting firm**, not a consumer products company
- The company was **founded in 2015** and is headquartered in **San Jose, California**
- Relim.ai is a **product by Sunware Technologies** — it was formerly called EdgeData360 before being rebranded in 2026
- The company has offices on **3 continents**: North America (USA), Asia (India), and Middle East (UAE)
- Primary contact: connect@sunwaretechnologies.com
- Google Analytics ID: G-698R671PW8
